items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was it called — well B.F. Skinner was a Hamilton College graduate.

ctx.x: Yeah. What’s almost weirder than the name is the fact that it was actually a real thing. First people assume it was just some made up nonsense and then you find out about the actual experiment. It’s still pretty much nonsense but it’s a little more realness to it.
Was it called — well B.F. Skinner was a Hamilton College graduate.
